source_witnesses.REG: Source directly loads original Q/SC packed words into registers, only X is cp.async staged. One WG, 64-row tiles, no widened prepare values.
source_witnesses.DECODE: One 16-register fragment replaces two; wait_group0 completes the asynchronous read before reuse. Exact dq unchanged.
source_witnesses.PAD: m64n48k16 WGMMA emitted; exact remaining rows choose16/32/48/64. Same weight bytes, precision and K reduction.
source_witnesses.OCC: 128threads,WG1,3stages,32-row tiles,38400 dynamic shared bytes. Residency advantage is a resource bound pending H200.
source_witnesses.BALANCE: Shared prefix over C/ORDER, uniform expert,row64,channel task index. No host route read or output caching.
source_witnesses.EPI: Original scale bits/global scales, early norm loads; finalizer14 is existing warp-only PDL implementation, no CTA shared exchange.

limitations: Instruction counts are static. No H200 occupancy or performance is inferred; EPI W2 retains incumbent spill4/4 at depth4.
